article.title: 墨西哥Soriana Media採用Kevel，首批廣告版位已上線
article.summary: 零售商Soriana旗下媒體業務選用Kevel提供廣告基礎設施，首批版位已在墨西哥上線。
highlights: 合作公告列出商品贊助、品牌贊助及展示廣告。
雙方計劃陸續擴展Soriana旗下數位渠道可用的廣告格式。
article.why: 欲進入墨西哥零售通路的品牌，可以比較商品曝光和展示廣告在購買前各自覆蓋的接觸點。
article.next_step: 先向Soriana索取已開放版位、商品上架要求和轉換歸因定義，再決定測試預算。
article.detail: Kevel公布，Soriana Media將以零售商自有的購買資料支援廣告，並計劃透過單一平台提供不同格式的報表。公告把直接加購列為技術可支援的例子，僅確認首批版位已上線。品牌可先確認哪種格式實際可買、能否按商品核對數據，以及報表是否涵蓋預定的販售渠道。
article.title_en: Soriana Media turns on first Mexican retail media placements powered by Kevel
article.summary_en: Mexican retailer Soriana's media business selected Kevel for its advertising infrastructure. The first placements are live in Mexico.
highlights_en: The announcement lists sponsored products, sponsored brands and display formats.
The partners plan to expand formats across Soriana's digital channels.
article.why_en: Brands entering Mexican retail can compare where sponsored products and display ads reach shoppers ahead of a purchase.
article.next_step_en: Ask Soriana which placements are bookable, what products qualify and how it defines a conversion before setting a test budget.
article.detail_en: Kevel says Soriana Media will use the retailer's own purchase data to support its ads and plans to report across formats on one platform. The release lists direct add-to-cart as an example of what the technology could support and confirms only the first placements are live. Brands can check which formats are bookable and whether reporting covers their products and sales channels.
